description: Does an AWS SNS subscription filter policy let this message through, and which key decided it: exact values, prefix, suffix, equals-ignore-case, wildcard, cidr, numeric ranges, anything-but, exists and $or, on MessageAttributes or on the JSON body (FilterPolicyScope=MessageBody). Also rejects what SNS would reject: more than 5 keys, more than 150 combinations, a policy over 256 KB. Built from the AWS documentation; there is no emulator to calibrate it against, and the answer says so.

message.description: MessageAttributes scope: { name: { "Type": "String"|"String.Array"|"Number"|"Binary", "Value": "..." } }. MessageBody scope: the JSON body

policy.description: The filter policy, as an object or JSON text

name: sns_filter
